summary: Validates the 6 required intake answers and, if sdr_id is given, persists them to that SDR (SDR.intake_answers + SDRIntake history). With no sdr_id it just validates and returns a reusable snapshot.

params.name: intake_answers
params.doc: Dict of the 6 required intake keys (+ optional anything_else). All 6 required keys must be present & non-blank or error_type='incomplete_intake'. Signature default is None, so it is effectively required despite being typed Optional.

params.name: sdr_id
params.doc: If provided, persists the validated intake to that SDR (must belong to active project). If omitted, only validates and returns the snapshot.

returns: no sdr_id: { status:'captured', intake{intake_version,answered_at,answers}, instructions_for_claude } | with sdr_id: { sdr_id, status:'captured', intake, instructions_for_claude } | incomplete: { error, error_type:'incomplete_intake', missing_required_keys[], questions[], instructions_for_claude }

summary: Re-scans connected sources and returns a cross-referenced diagnosis (findings + readiness) without writing. sdr_id optional — if given, pulls that SDR's intake + current event names to enrich the diagnosis.

params.name: sdr_id
params.doc: Optional. When provided, the SDR's persisted intake_answers and current event names feed the diagnosis. Must belong to the active project or access_denied.

params.name: connector_filter
params.doc: Array of source-name strings to limit the scan; same alias normalization as generate (ads -> google_ads). Omit to scan all.

returns: { sdr_id, status: 'diagnosis_ready', connected_sources, findings[{type,severity,summary,evidence,affected_events,recommendation,fix_location}], readiness{critical_findings_unresolved,events_volume_proven,primary_conversion_proven,unfilled_roles[]}, instructions_for_claude } | {error,error_type,message}

summary: Gathers SDR source data: with no intake_answers returns the 6 intake questions; with answers it scans connected sources and returns structured facts, findings, readiness, a parse-valid markdown_skeleton and a synthesis playbook. Writes NOTHING.

params.name: intake_answers

example.business_model: B2B SaaS selling compliance automation to mid-market finance teams, freemium + usage-based
example.primary_kpis: demo->paid conversion, time-to-value, feature adoption depth
example.conversion_definition: qualified demo request w/ corp email + company size > 20
example.key_journeys: free trial -> activation -> paid; content view -> demo request
example.privacy_consent: OneTrust CMP, marketing tags consent-gated, GDPR+CCPA
example.ownership_complexity: analytics eng owns taxonomy, marketing ops owns destinations, server-side fires revenue events
example.anything_else: two brands share one GA4 property

params.doc: Dict of the 6 REQUIRED intake keys (business_model, primary_kpis, conversion_definition, key_journeys, privacy_consent, ownership_complexity) plus optional anything_else. Omit entirely to receive the questions. If present but any required key missing/blank -> incomplete_intake error (unless phase='scan').

params.name: project_id
params.doc: Target project; defaults to active project. Pass to be race-free when set_active_project is called in the same parallel batch.

params.name: name
params.doc: SDR name; defaults to '<project_name> SDR'.

params.name: sources
params.doc: Array of source-name strings. Aliases normalized: 'ads'/'googleads' -> 'google_ads'. If provided, OVERRIDES the sources_ga4/sources_gtm/sources_ads booleans entirely.

params.name: sources_ga4
params.doc: Include GA4 in scan. Only consulted when `sources` is not provided.

params.name: sources_gtm
params.doc: Include GTM in scan. Only consulted when `sources` is not provided.

params.name: sources_ads
params.doc: Include Google Ads in scan. Only consulted when `sources` is not provided.

params.name: business_type_hint
params.doc: Industry overlay for template events. If omitted, inferred from intake then from scanned events.

params.name: phase
params.doc: Lowercased. phase='scan' bypasses BOTH the awaiting_intake gate AND the incomplete_intake validation, letting a scan run with zero/partial intake. 'interview' is accepted but behaves like 'auto' (only 'scan' is special-cased).

params.name: regenerate
params.doc: Echoed back as regenerate_requested. NOTE: generate never writes, so this flag has no effect on persisted state in v2 (overwrite semantics live in save).

returns: awaiting_intake: { status, intake_version, questions[6+1], message, instructions_for_claude, next_action } | incomplete_intake error: { error, error_type, missing_required_keys[], questions, instructions_for_claude } | data_gathered: { sdr_id (existing or null), status, name, intake{intake_version,answered_at,answers}, connected_sources, scans, industry_template{business_type,events[],rationale}, scan_summary, findings[{type,severity,summary,evidence,affected_events,recommendation,fix_location}], readiness{critical_findings_unresolved,events_volume_proven,primary_conversion_proven,unfilled_roles[]}, reproducibility, regenerate_requested, markdown_skeleton, instructions_for_claude }

summary: Re-surfaces the persisted intake answers for an SDR plus the full SDRIntake history. Read-only.

params.name: sdr_id
params.doc: The SDR whose intake to fetch. Required positional. Must belong to the active project.

returns: { sdr_id, status:'intake_found', intake{intake_version,answers}, history[], instructions_for_claude } | { sdr_id, status:'no_intake', instructions_for_claude } | {error,error_type,message}

summary: Reports supported sources, currently-scannable sources, connected-but-unsupported sources, and (if sdr_id given) the last-scanned set + timestamp. Read-only.

params.name: sdr_id
params.doc: Optional. If given, adds last_scan_sources + last_full_source_scan_at from that SDR (must belong to active project).

returns: { sdr_id, supported_sources[ga4,gtm,google_ads], available_now[], connected_but_unsupported[], last_scan_sources[], last_full_source_scan_at|null, instructions_for_claude } | {error,error_type,message}

summary: DISPATCHER-LEVEL refine: routes to refine_sdr, whose OWN `action` kwarg (inside params) drives a 10-state refinement state machine. The dispatcher-level action must be 'refine'; the real behavior is selected by params.action (default 'resume'). sdr_id is required for every sub-action.

params.name: sdr_id
params.doc: The SDR to refine. Required positional for ALL sub-actions. Must belong to the active project (access_denied otherwise).

params.name: action
params.doc: INTERNAL state-machine action living inside params. THIS IS NOT the dispatcher action. Invalid value -> error_type='invalid_action'. See the refine:<subaction> records for the params each one needs.

params.name: section
params.doc: Required only for goto_section. Allows the 9 SECTION_ORDER values plus event_catalog.<event_name> sub-sections.

params.name: user_input
params.doc: Required only for submit_answer (natural-language user response).

params.name: source_delta
params.doc: Required only for apply_source_delta — the refresh_sources payload (or its `deltas`).

params.name: changelog_note
params.doc: Required for finalize when a prior version exists (>1.0). Contains '[major]' to force a major version bump.

returns: Varies per sub-action; common envelope: { sdr_id, current_section, progress{...}, status_after_call, can_finalize, can_skip, proposed_changes|null, instructions_for_claude, user_options[] } | {error,error_type,message}. See refine:<subaction> records.

summary: Re-scans connectors for an existing SDR and returns structured deltas (added/missing events, destination & parameter changes, ready-to-stage proposals) plus before/after source fingerprints. Writes nothing.

params.name: sdr_id
params.doc: The SDR to diff against. Must belong to the active project.

params.name: connector_filter
params.doc: Limit the re-scan to these sources; alias-normalized (ads -> google_ads).

params.name: reuse_intake
params.doc: If True and the SDR has stored intake answers, returns them in `intake`; else intake is null.

returns: { sdr_id, status:'delta_ready', reuse_intake, intake|null, connected_sources, scans, deltas{added_events[],removed_or_missing_from_scan[],destination_changes[],parameter_changes[],proposals[]}, reproducibility{previous_source_fingerprint,current_source_fingerprint,scan_timestamp}, instructions_for_claude } | {error,error_type,message}

summary: Persists Claude-authored SDR markdown. Validates against the markdown contract (round-trip parse) before any DB write; errors block unless force=true. Creates the SDR if none exists for the project, else OVERWRITES the existing project SDR's markdown and bumps draft_version.

params.name: markdown
params.doc: The full SDR document. Required and must be non-blank, else error_type='invalid_markdown'. Must contain a parseable Event Catalog (>=1 event) or validation fails.

params.name: intake_snapshot
params.doc: The `intake` object returned by generate. Normalized (accepts answers or intake_answers key). Persisted to SDR.intake_answers + SDRIntake history if present.

params.name: source_snapshot
params.doc: The `scans` object from generate. If not None it is stored as SDR.last_source_scan and used to compute the returned readiness.

params.name: name
params.doc: SDR name; defaults to existing name on update or '<project_name> SDR' on create.

params.name: sdr_id
params.doc: Update a specific existing draft. If omitted, the tool finds the (single) SDR for the project and overwrites it, or creates one.

params.name: source_snapshot_id
params.doc: Opaque id echoed back as source_snapshot_id; not used for any lookup.

params.name: create_initial_refinement_state
params.doc: Seed refinement state + mark sections complete from the parsed markdown so refine can resume immediately.

params.name: force
params.doc: Override structural validation errors and persist anyway. Use only intentionally — bypasses the round-trip contract gate.

params.name: source_xlsx_base64
params.doc: Base64 of a source .xlsx so users can download the original. Hard limit 2 MB (2*1024*1024 bytes) of DECODED bytes; must be valid base64 AND a valid openpyxl-loadable workbook. On any failure it is silently skipped (logged as a warning) — the save still succeeds without the file.

params.name: source_filename
params.doc: Filename for the stored xlsx, truncated to 255 chars; defaults to 'source.xlsx'.

returns: validation_failed (errors & !force): { error, error_type:'validation_failed', validation{errors[],warnings[]}, instructions_for_claude } | success: { sdr_id, status:'draft_saved', draft_version, source_snapshot_id, source_snapshot_saved, sections_completed[], sections_remaining[], readiness|null, validation{errors[],warnings[]}, summary{events,todo_count,gaps,intake_version}, recommended_next_action, instructions_for_claude }

summary: Return the full structured tracking plan for the active project's main branch (events, property library, sources, destinations, routing, mappings, metrics). Pass summary=true for counts only.

params.name: summary
params.doc: If true, return counts instead of the full plan.

returns: { plan, branch, categories[], events[], properties{event[],user[],group[],system[]}, sources[], destinations[], metrics[] } | { plan, counts }

summary: Return a single event with its attached properties and destination mappings. Look up by name or event_id.

params.name: name
params.doc: Event name to look up. Provide name or event_id.

params.name: event_id
params.doc: Event UUID to look up. Provide event_id or name.

returns: { id, name, display_name, description, category_id, tags, trigger_type, trigger_config, purpose, properties[], destinations[] } | { error, error_type:'not_found', message }

summary: Validate the working draft and return a findings report (missing required properties, duplicate names, unrouted events, etc.). Read-only.
returns: { findings[{ severity, code, message, entity_type, entity_id }] }

summary: Create an event on the working draft (main branch). Validated against the schema.

params.name: name
params.doc: Unique event name on the branch.

params.name: display_name
params.doc: Human-friendly label.

params.name: category_id
params.doc: UUID of an existing category.

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Update fields on an existing event. Only supplied fields are changed.

params.name: event_id
params.doc: UUID of the event to update.

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Delete an event from the working draft. Also removes all property attachments and destination mappings for that event.

params.name: event_id
params.doc: UUID of the event to delete.

returns: { ok: true, deleted } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Replace the full set of source links for an event (idempotent). Pass an empty sources array to clear all links.

params.name: event_id

params.name: sources
params.doc: Array of { source_id, implementation_status } objects. implementation_status: planned | implemented | deprecated.

returns: { ok: true, event_id, source_count } | { error, error_type, message }

params.name: destination_id

params.name: dest_event_name

params.name: property_mappings

params.name: parent_property_id
params.doc: Parent UUID for object/array members.

params.name: property_id
params.doc: UUID of the property to update.

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

params.name: platform_type

params.name: connector_ref
params.doc: Optional reference to a connected source integration.

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }
